how_it_sees_the_problem: a repeated within-subject manipulation of box distance
what_it_separates: in-box vs out-of-box urination at two distances
what_it_assumes: substrate and cleaning frequency held constant across the manipulation
what_it_would_say_against_us: a single cat's second observation window is still n=1 -- does not rule out a time-varying confound such as the cat habituating over the two weeks, rather than distance itself
